items.position: Without settling whether AI is a bubble, Krugman asks what follows if it is bursting: he concludes it would almost surely cause a recession, leans toward it being worse than the slump after the late-1990s tech boom, and expects a slow recovery with unemployment elevated for years and an inadequate policy response.
